# App Specification: Timely

## High Level Overview
- Timely takes an origin time
- Origin time defaults to current time in day
- The user can add 0 or more intervals to the origin time
- The unit may be seconds, minutes, hours, days, or years
- The app displays and updates the result automatically


## Specifications

- Use Svelte
- Should be able to change origin time
- Take times as float, allow negatives


### Graph Feature
- Graph features shows how the intervals bring you forward and backwards in time
- Go from left to right, showing time at each interval relative to the base interval as 
a horizontal line

### Style
- Use a clock icon
